page_title: AI Anime Generator – Anime Art from Text & Photos

sources.entry: AI Anime Generator - Create anime portraits and original characters from text or reference images, with 40 one-time signup credits. #freemium

summary.name: AI Anime Generator
summary.one_liner: A web-based AI tool that creates anime portraits, original characters and chibis from text prompts or uploaded photos, with optional short video and filter features.
use_cases: Turn a personal photo into an anime-style portrait
Invent an original anime character or scene from a text description
Make an anime profile picture or festive PFP
Create a short silent MP4 clip from an anime image
Design anime wallpaper or scenic illustration concepts
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a generator where users write a text description or upload a photo (HEIC, JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 40 MB), pick an anime style such as Waifu, Realistic, Chibi, Retro, Fantasy, Cyberpunk, Pixel or School, and choose an aspect ratio. Generation uses account credits, with the cost shown on the button before each image. Generated anime images can be animated into short silent MP4 videos with selectable model, resolution and duration, and there is a star-eye selfie filter and dance generator. The page states the image model is GPT Image 2.6 (Flare or Sunburst), each costing 15 credits per still image, with native GIF output noted as a separate workflow.
notable: 40 one-time signup credits that never expire
Text-to-anime and photo-to-anime in one generator, with style choices
Anime image can be animated into a short silent MP4 video
caveats: Credit packs start at $4.99; no subscription is required, but generation is paid per credit after the signup bonus
Sign-in with Google is required before generating
Anime styles reinterpret facial details, so likeness to the source photo is not guaranteed; the star-eye filter can change facial details and eye placement
Commercial use depends on the site's Terms, the model's terms and rights to reference images
